footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Concentra: after $6.4M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $2.2M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 13.9% to $2.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 28.3%, versus 27.8% a year earlier, and operating income rose 9.6% to $334M, a 15.4% margin.
Net income fell 1.4% to $164M, or $1.30 per share. Operating cash flow was $279M and free cash flow $197M, versus $210M; Concentra returned $54.5M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Concentra Group Holdings Parent, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
